name: @absolutejs/insights
description: Product insights for AbsoluteJS applications: record what people do (on the server, and in the browser with consent) and read active people, weekly retention cohorts, activation funnels, feature usage and a per-person timeline. Drizzle-native, Postgres.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/drizzle.ts src/browser.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --target=bun --external drizzle-orm --external 'drizzle-orm/*' && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && absolute-changelog check
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
